verdict.rationale: cubic's AI wiki indexes the codebase into searchable wikis with source links and architecture diagrams, and exports them as markdown kept current in the repo. That gives the team a shared, repo-derived knowledge base. Cross-repo linking lets related repositories, including docs, be considered together during reviews, but it is a review feature, not a workspace. missing for 10: ingesting external docs (not only code) into the workspace, an explicit team-shared workspace construct combining multiple repos and docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the wiki.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team

citations.quote: cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes your codebase and produces searchable wikis, complete with links to source code, architecture diagrams, and more.
cubic exports the wiki as markdown files into a directory in your repo (default `.cubic/wiki`) and keeps them current through a rolling pull request.
Link related repositories so reviews can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work.
